notes: BLS QCEW Open Data API, NAICS 5415 (Computer Systems Design and Related Services), private ownership, summed across NYC's 5 constituent counties (Bronx/Kings/New York/Queens/Richmond) -- the same convention already established for this jurisdiction's business_formation metric. No suppression at the borough level for this NAICS code in any year -- this metric is genuinely more tractable at city-proper scope than life_sciences_employment or advanced_manufacturing_employment, whose niche NAICS codes trigger suppression in most outer boroughs.
Same source/methodology as 2015. 2025 not imported -- only an H1 average (Q3/Q4 not yet released by BLS) is currently available, not a full-year figure.
